土星五号升空后逐渐转向。烧空的级段分离，剩下的火箭继续加速。去月球，先要绕过地球: Saturn V turns as it climbs. Empty stages fall away; the remaining rocket keeps accelerating. The route to the Moon begins around Earth.
横向速度接近每秒 7.8 公里，飞船进入约 190 公里高的停泊轨道。发动机关掉: At nearly 7.8 kilometres per second sideways, the craft enters a parking orbit about 190 kilometres up. The engine stops. The orbit continues.
把圆轨道拉向月球: Stretch an orbit toward the Moon.
末级再次点火约六分钟，提高速度，把轨道拉成长椭圆。目的地是三天后月球的位置，不是: The final stage fires again for about six minutes, stretching the orbit into a long ellipse. It aims where the Moon will be three days later.
飞船继续沿弯曲的轨迹前进。大部分航程靠惯性与引力，只需少量修正；指令舱、服务舱和: The spacecraft keeps following a curved path, coasting with occasional corrections. The command, service and lunar modules travel together.
地球与月球的引力始终同时存在。靠近月球时，它对飞船的影响越来越强；但引力本身不会: Both worlds pull on the craft throughout the journey. The Moon’s influence grows as it approaches. Gravity alone will not make it stay.
在月球背面，飞船掉头，发动机逆着运动方向推。约六分钟的制动降低轨道能量，让飞掠变: Behind the Moon, the craft turns to thrust against its motion. About six minutes of braking lowers its orbital energy, turning a flyby into an orbit.
第四天，成为月球的卫星: Day four. A satellite of the Moon.
约 76 小时抵达环月轨道，随后再点火圆化到约 110 公里高。到达的是月球轨道: Lunar orbit comes about 76 hours after launch. A later burn circularizes it at roughly 110 kilometres. Landing is a different journey.
